1981-2415-6094-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2415-6094-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

643-3967-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-3967-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1286-4247-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1150-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Melira's Keepers
When Melira's Keepers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

757-4883-5087-5524.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-4883-5087-5524.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Contagion Clasp to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Destiny Spinner, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

4905-5220-6900-7492.description:
Cast Fanatical Firebrand by paying its mana cost.
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-4779-6972.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1169-1563-3899-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1090-1739-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-2921-3220-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a slumber counter on it

3201-4091-7791.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Arixmethes.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Arixmethes.
Repeat.

969-1368-2033-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
969-1368-2033-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

855-3099-4762-6627.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to The Earth Crystal and Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

643-2366-5256-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
643-2366-5256-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1661-4195-4211-4574.description:
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

339-677-2921-5223.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

372-2974-3603.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Cloudshift.
372-2974-3603.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Cloudshift.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2511-5058-6351.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

478-2821-3664-3918-6256.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-2821-3664-3918-6256.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Muraganda Raceway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Muraganda Raceway.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

413-710-1258.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Abduction triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Danitha trigger, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2178-2440-3143-3490.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature with one or more +1/+1 counters on it.
You control at least one other creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2440-3143-3490.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Xavier Sal triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters among creatures you control, you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control, and gaining infinite colorless mana due to Mana Echoes.

1879-4499-4747.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

1069-1374-4068-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
You control at least one Mountain.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-4068-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-2775.description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Saproling tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Saprolings die, Slimefoot triggers twice, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

2178-2366-3346-4452-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Bog Glider.
"Mercenary" chosen with Rukarumel.
2178-2366-3346-4452-5220.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary and Bog Glider trigger.
Resolve the Bog Glider trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability from step 1, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2097-2837-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2097-2837-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Jolene triggers, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste due to Jinnie Fay and Jolene.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite Cat tokens, you may instead make Dog tokens using Jinnie Fay or Treasure tokens, which can then be used to activate Jolene's ability.

57-914-2178-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
57-914-2178-5147.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Feldon triggers, untapping Feldon.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1624-1927-3646-4827.manaNeeded: {8}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1624-1927-3646-4827.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Strovald by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Storvald enters the battlefield, it triggers, giving Evra base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Evra by paying {4}, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

2470-2645-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Staff of Domination to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Grand Architect's first ability by paying {U}, causing Staff of Domination to become blue until end of turn.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping Staff of Domination, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead tap Staff of Domination using its other abilities if it does not have summoning sickness.

1642-2499-2682.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least three.
Warlock Class is level three.
1642-2499-2682.description:
Cast Dire Fleet Ravager by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Dire Fleet Ravager enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Dire Fleet Ravager trigger, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
Resolve the second Dire Fleet Ravager trigger, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

617-1737-3094-4636.notablePrerequisites: Eleven generic mana available each turn.
617-1737-3094-4636.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {6} and tapping it.
In response, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Prototype Portal's activated ability.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Lithoform Engine.
activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Prototype Portal's activated ability again.
Resolve one Prototype Portal ability, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, adding {E}{E}.
Resolve a second Prototype Portal ability, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
Put one of the Gonti's Aether Heart tokens into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Gonti's Aether Heart copies trigger, adding a total of {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve the last Prototype Portal ability, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
Put one of the Gonti's Aether Heart tokens into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Gonti's Aether Heart copies trigger, adding a total of {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate the Gonti's Aether Heart token by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness

116-283-1430.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Mirror Image.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Mirror Image and another permanent you control.
Activate Mirror Image by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

780-3191-4050.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying {B}, targeting Kairi.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kairi, adding {B}.
Kairi dies, triggering its ability granted by Supernatural Stamina and its other ability.
Resolve the first Kairi trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the second Kairi trigger, causing you to mill six cards and return Supernatural Stamina from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3175-4681-4812-5147.description:
Cast Sun Titan.
Sun Titan enters the battlefield, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
With the Animate Dead trigger on the stack, Activate Goblin Bombardment, sacrificing Sun Titan to deal one damage to any target.
Resolve the Animate Dead trigger, causing it to become an Aura with "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Animate Dead" and returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Animate Dead is put into your graveyard due to state based actions, as it cannot attach to a creature with protection from black.
Animate Dead triggers, causing you to sacrifice Karmic Guide.
Karmic Guide's enter the battlefield triggers.
Resolve Karmic Guide's enter the battlefield trigger returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
